subject: curved greenhouse glass with rain

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Study a curved greenhouse roof after rain, keeping its thin structural ribs in the lower half. Small droplets and soft green plant reflections overlap on the glass, while pale daylight turns the upper area luminous and simple. Show clean metal edges and restrained water detail. The composition feels sheltered and abstract, with no signs, people or dense foliage filling the view. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
